name: Angelic celestial plate armor, form-fitting
description: celestial armor of polished {{METAL}}: two small ornate filigree plates, each in the form of a curved feather sweeping outward at the tip, each curved to follow the natural contour of the breast and sitting close against the skin, hugging the form, covering the centre of each breast fully, and one matching small ornate plate in the form of a small halo ring with two short feathers curved to follow the contour of the pelvic area, tapering and sitting flush against the skin, covering the whole front of the pelvic area completely; every plate is engraved with fine barbs of filigree and tiny drifting stars and set with a {{GEM}} gem; each plate hangs against the skin held by magic alone, weightless and unconnected to any other; the rest of the torso, the sides of the hips, the back, shoulders and arms are bare skin
notes: The angelic plate armor shaped to follow the contour of the body.
